option_relations.rationale: Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome–A (MIS-A) with Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage is a distinct diagnosis not directly related to COVID-19 vaccine-induced thrombocytopenia.
Lupus-related diffuse alveolar hemorrhage is an autoimmune condition, distinct from COVID-19 vaccine-induced thrombocytopenia.
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (Wegener's granulomatosis) is a vasculitis, distinct from COVID-19 vaccine-induced thrombocytopenia.
COVID-19 vaccine-associated multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS-A-like) is a different syndrome than COVID-19 vaccine-induced thrombocytopenia, although both are related to the vaccine.
